paragraphs.text: Magar is a minotaur performer who works for Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Magar is a puppeteer whose specialty is making and performing with cursed marionettes. There are rumors throughout the park about the source of the dark magic he uses to make his marionettes. All that is known is that those who mess with Magar, talk during his show, or volunteer during a performance, tend to disappear, and people swear they are later seen as part of his performances. He is nonetheless considered one of the park's highlights.
